column1: #  - fn is function, with or without @test, @init, @fini, @noreturn or @symbol attributes, with or without a body; the return type is never a definition;

#  - type NAME = struct, union or enum is class; every other type (alias to a named or built-in type, tuple, tagged union, function type, pointer, slice, array, nullable, error type !void) is type_alias;
#  - def NAME and a top-level const are constant, a top-level let is variable; the export keyword changes nothing;
#  - locals in a function body, fields, enum members and parameters are not definitions.
